# Curater (curater.org)

Curater's public signed-out surface — the trending home, the /feed themes-and-curations grid, the /taste TasteScope teaser, a /curation/<id> detail, a /ravi profile and /terms — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and feed at 390 x 844. Curater is a platform for curating and discovering taste (a visual-curation community); the signed-in app behind 'Log in or sign up' was never entered, and nothing was submitted.

Read this before designing in this style. Take every value from [tokens.json](tokens.json), never from the screenshots; `python3 tools/catalog.py export curater` prints them all with aliases resolved.

### Principles

The README has no "Do and don't" section, so this package states no principles.

### Using tokens

| Role | light |
|---|---|
| page | #ffffff `light.color.background.page` |
| surface | #f2f2f2 `light.color.background.app-field` |
| text | #09090b `light.color.text.text` |
| muted | #71717b `light.color.text.muted` |
| accent | #d83acb `core.color.curater.pink` |
| border | #eeeef1 `light.color.border.border` |

Fonts: `core.font.family.sans` is ABCDiatype, then 11 fallbacks. Scales, counted as [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) holds them: no type styles under `core.typography`, 7 radius steps (`core.radius`), 15 spacing steps (`core.spacing`).

### Using components

Read [components.md](components.md) for the component inventory; [patterns.md](patterns.md) for how components combine into screens; 108 element crops in [components/crops/](components/crops); [style-guide.html](style-guide.html), which renders every token and the main components.

### Accessibility

| Theme | text on page | text on surface | muted on page | muted on surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| light | 19.89:1 pass | 17.77:1 pass | 4.82:1 pass | 4.31:1 fail |

3 of 4 pairs pass 4.5:1 (WCAG AA for body text), the pairs the scorecard's F15 check grades. Focus tokens: `light.component.focus-ring` 2px solid oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286) offset 2px.

## What was captured

- One painted theme, no toggle: every page is light (#fff page/cards over the #f2f2f2 app field, #09090b ink, #71717b muted). The only dark-looking surface is the TasteScope teaser's WebGL globe — a canvas asset, not a theme.
- The declared :root var layer (177 resolved vars): the `--Curater-*` product namespace (#f2f2f2 background, gray ramp, green/pink/red/yellow accents, the 9-hue `--Curater-selection-*` tag palette), the shadcn semantic set (`--background/--foreground/--muted*/--primary/--ring/--border/--input/--accent/--destructive/--card/--popover/--sidebar-*`), the Tailwind `--color-*` subset, the `--space-*` 4px scale, `--radius-*` (incl. the 9999px pill), the `--text-*` ramp, `--shadow-*`, `--transition-*`/`--ease-out-expo`, `--z-*` layers, `--container-*`, `--header-height`, `--sidebar-width` and `--centered-content-width`.
- 47 measured components: the 48x328 icon rail with its round 48px buttons (active page fills #f2f2f2), the 259x58 'Sign in / Create account' white pill (fills #f2f2f2 and sinks 2px on press), the feed tabs and collapsible 170px search field, the 544x492 trend card (24px radius, soft lift), the 224x271 theme tiles, title links, the 28px Save chip, media items, the curation detail's back/options/SSO/'search similar on' controls, the profile items, the terms column and the mobile 160x40 nav bar.

## Boundaries

- **Captured with the automation flag masked.** The public capture (`tools/capture/public/`) hid `navigator.webdriver` from every page, so the committed readings and screenshots it took were taken past that mask. The scripts no longer hide it (edited, not run); a recapture that meets a bot check records it as a boundary.
- The signed-in app (creating curations, the TasteScope questionnaire, saving items, settings) sits behind 'Log in or sign up' / the Google SSO button and was never reached; every captured control was measured, never followed.
- /feed scrolls in an inner container (not the document): the desktop full-page capture is bounded at the first 27,850px and mobile at 57,550px — the tail is a documented boundary.
- One curation (/curation/qDNMdxe5) and one profile (/ravi) were captured as representatives of their page types; the catalog's full range is not enumerated.
- Disabled, error and loading states never appeared on the public surface.
- **`core.spacing.content-w` (480px) was resolved at 1280 wide, not 1440.** The resolution probe in `tools/capture/vars.mjs` ran at Playwright's 1280 x 720 default, where `--centered-content-width` resolves to 30rem. At the 1440 x 900 the notes name, the declared `@media (min-width: 90rem)` rule sets it to 35rem (560px). The probe now uses 1440 x 900 (edited, not run); the token needs a recapture.
- The /taste route client-side redirects to /taste/soon; Playwright locators never resolve on it, so its components are measured through main-world DOM queries (the values are the same computed styles).
- No standalone SVG icon set was lifted on this pass; the glyphs are visible in the crops and screenshots — declared under `layoutGaps` in the catalog entry.
